description: This PHP source file defines the ChartDao class within the OrangeHRM project. The class is responsible for data access related to organizational charts, specifically functions to retrieve employee distribution by subunit, location, and total active employees. It interacts with entity classes such as Employee, Subunit, and EmpLocations, and utilizes query builders to perform database queries.

classes.name: ChartDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for fetching organizational chart data such as employee distribution by subunit and location, total active employees, and unassigned employees.

methods.name: getEmployeeDistributionBySubunit
methods.description: Retrieves a list of SubunitCountPair objects representing employee counts grouped by organizational subunits at level 1.

methods.name: getUnassignedEmployeeCount
methods.description: Returns the count of employees not assigned to any subunit.

methods.name: getEmployeeCount
methods.description: Private helper method that executes a query based on provided EmployeeSearchFilterParams to return the count of matching employees.

methods.name: getEmployeeDistributionQueryBuilderWrapper
methods.description: Constructs and returns a QueryBuilderWrapper object configured to query employees based on provided filter parameters.

methods.name: getTotalActiveEmployeeCount
methods.description: Returns the count of employees who are currently active (not terminated or purged).

methods.name: getEmployeeDistributionByLocation
methods.description: Retrieves an array of LocationEmployeeCount objects representing employee counts per location, excluding terminated and purged employees.
